Coerce Metadata to the Dataset-Metadata Contract

Source: R/metadata.R
as_dataset_metadata.Rd

Normalizes the accepted metadata inputs into a tidy table with one row per dataset, describing how completely each dataset itself is documented. A metacore object contributes its ds_spec (dataset label and structure) and the count of key variables recorded in ds_vars (those with a key_seq); a data.frame is checked for the required dataset column and completed with any missing optional columns.

as_dataset_metadata(metadata)

Arguments

metadata

Either a Metacore object or a data.frame with at least the column dataset. Optional columns label, structure, and n_keys are used when present. A logical has_keys column is accepted in place of n_keys.

Value

A tibble with columns dataset, label, structure, and n_keys.

See also

dataset_metadata_to_evidence(), as_variable_metadata()

Examples

# The CDISC pilot ADaM metacore specification shipped with metacore.
load(metacore::metacore_example("pilot_ADaM.rda"))
head(as_dataset_metadata(metacore))
#> # A tibble: 5 × 4
#>   dataset label                                structure                  n_keys
#>   <chr>   <chr>                                <chr>                       <int>
#> 1 ADSL    Subject-Level Analysis Dataset       one record per subject. S…      1
#> 2 ADADAS  ADAS-Cog Analysis                    one record per subject pe…      4
#> 3 ADLBC   Analysis Dataset Lab Blood Chemistry one record per subject pe…      4
#> 4 ADTTE   AE Time To 1st Derm. Event Analysis  one record per subject pe…      2
#> 5 ADAE    Adverse Events Analysis Dataset      one record per subject pe…      4
